digraph_sum.note: The disjoint union (sum) of two finite digraphs on D1 + D2: the arcs of D1 between left vertices, those of D2 between right vertices, no arc across in either direction; loops and asymmetric arcs kept, either summand may be empty, #|V| = #|D1| + #|D2|. Not a join (heroes.djoin, X122 x122_dijoin add left-to-right arcs). The simple-graph union is upstream sjoin.
